shared_elements: bilaterally symmetrical composition on a shaped plaque
central rectangular/vertical field enclosed by outlines
flanking projections at the upper corners
justification: Both surfaces present a single symmetrical, vertically oriented design on a lobed plaque with a defined central field flanked by lateral projections, and A's nested incised outlines could conceivably schematize a torso in the way B's figure occupies its panel. But B depicts a fully articulated frontal anthropomorph with head, headdress, necklace, arms, legs and feather-like flanking elements rendered with abundant internal detail, whereas A shows only bare nested contour lines and a few faint marks with no identifiable creature, body part or motif.
